description: This file implements the scrypt key derivation function, including core functions like salsa208_word_specification, scryptBlockMix, scryptROMix, and EVP_PBE_scrypt, following RFC 7914 and using OpenSSL libraries.

methods.name: salsa208_word_specification
methods.description: Implements the Salsa20/8 core function, modifies a block in-place.

methods.name: xor_block
methods.description: Performs XOR operation between two blocks.

methods.name: scryptBlockMix
methods.description: Implements the scrypt block mixing function as per RFC 7914.

methods.name: scryptROMix
methods.description: Performs the ROMix operation for scrypt, mixing and memory-hard processing.

methods.name: EVP_PBE_scrypt
methods.description: Main function to derive key using scrypt with given parameters, following RFC 7914.
